questions.q: What question does the segment page need to answer directly?
options: The sales mix between Individual customers and Store/Reseller customers
Which territory sells the most
How many products are in inventory
A forecast of next quarter's sales
questions.explain: This page exists specifically to answer the Marketing Manager's original Lesson 1 question.

questions.q: What visual shows the core sales-mix answer at a glance?
options: A donut or stacked bar chart with CustomerSegment on legend/axis and Total Sales as the value
A single unfiltered card with no segment breakdown
A map visual
A scatter plot of OrderDate vs LineTotal
questions.explain: A donut or stacked bar directly visualizes the share between the two segments.

questions.q: Which measure should every card and chart on this page be bound to?
options: [Total Sales] (or [Order Count]), the plain filter-responsive measures
[Total Sales (All Segments)], the benchmark measure, for every visual
[Total Sales (All Territories)]
No measure -- raw column aggregation only
questions.explain: The plain measures respond correctly to the segment slicer; the benchmark measure is reserved for its specific denominator role.

questions.q: Where does [Pct of Company Total (Segment)] appear on this page?
options: Only in the detail table, where its denominator role is explicit next to the numbers it compares
On every card on the page
It doesn't appear anywhere on this page
As the page's only visual
questions.explain: Confining the benchmark-based measure to the detail table keeps its role clear and visible.

questions.q: Why does this lesson emphasize building the page carefully, right before Lesson 11?
options: With three similarly-named 'Total Sales' measures in the Fields pane, moving quickly while building the next page is exactly when a wrong-measure binding mistake tends to happen
Lesson 11's page uses an entirely different data model
Power BI requires pages to be built in a specific order
Careful building has no bearing on later lessons
questions.explain: This sets up the realistic binding mistake that Lessons 13-15 later diagnose and fix.
